messages:
alex: Quick proposal before we onboard the new customer KMS: tighten SIEM export retention and lock down raw security log reads.

alex: TL;DR:
- dev/testing logs -> 7 days in hot index
- prod security indexes -> 90 days hot, 7 years cold (S3 Glacier) encrypted with customer CMK
- create 2 SIEM roles: siem_reader (search only, no raw-log download), forensics_admin (JIT escalate)
- require explicit KMS decrypt permission for cold-restore jobs

sara: +1. Migration plan for existing buckets? cost estimate?

alex: Migration plan draft: reindex prod hot -> lifecycle policy moves to S3 prefix /archive/<YYYY-MM>/, restore jobs as needed. Rough cost ballpark: +12% storage, -8% query cost over time (depends on compression).

dinesh: How will this affect vuln triage? If forensics_admin is JIT-only, on-call needs fast access during incidents.

maria: Incident flow suggestion:
1) Pager -> on-call requests temp role via 2FA -> sec-lead approves -> role granted 4h
2) Audit log entry + snapshot of queries run.
Will update runbook.

jamal: Are we keeping Splunk and Datadog pipelines or consolidating? Design should be agnostic.

alex: Keep both for now. Export outputs must include encryption-context with key-id header so downstream can verify CMK ownership.

sara: Can someone draft a sample IAM/KMS policy for the restore job so I can wire IaC?

alex: Dev sketch below (policy must be reviewed):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-sec-archive/*"}
  ]
}
```

sara: Add condition to require aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent for forensics_admin.

dinesh: Also add a narrow IP allowlist for restore API calls (jumpbox only).

maria: We need CloudTrail KMS key usage events fed into the SIEM so we can trace key usage post-incident.

sec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-4521 — "SIEM export RBAC & KMS onboarding" assigned to @sara, due 2026-02-10. https://redwood.ai/board/SEC-4521

jamal: Developer access question: should devs see anonymized logs? I think expose only meta fields (request_id, trace, error_code) and redact PII.

alex: Yes. dev role = dev_siem_limited; allowed fields: timestamp, service, level, trace_id, error_code, message_meta. No user identifiers.

sara: ACTION: @sara to draft RBAC matrix + infra PR for KMS policy. @maria to update incident runbook. @dinesh to add jumpbox allowlist. Target: RFC by EOD next Wed.

maria: I'll add runbook changes and a checklist for post-incident KMS audit extraction.

dinesh: I'll run a test restore and validate latency + redaction.

alex: If no objections I'll open the RFC doc and link infra PR tomorrow.

jamal: :thumbsup: 

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: SEC-4521 review in 3 days.
